text:
maya: Drafting a compact PRD fragment for generation edge-cases we need to ship for the hosted API. Focus: streaming resume, truncation semantics, token-limit behavior, and retry policies. Want clear acceptance criteria and owners. Please list concrete test scenarios and any hard constraints.

devon: I'll kick off with quick scenarios: client disconnect + resume; truncation in the middle of a JSON/fn payload; server kills a stream at model token cap; client retries and causes duplicate webhook calls; byte-split in SSE causing invalid utf-8; billing vs emitted token mismatch.

anil: runtime constraints to highlight: resume must be stateless (HMAC signed token), include model fingerprint, request_id, offset. No cross-variant resume. Retries that change backend node must preserve KV/cache semantics or be rejected.

carla: customer asks: LegalAssist hit a tool-call truncated mid-arg and the SDK tried to parse and crashed. They want an explicit partial flag and a safe-retry pattern. FinOps wants a deterministic bill mapping when truncation happens.

jessica: support note: many customers just retry on 5xx. We should provide an SDK helper that signals "safe to retry" and documents non-idempotent behavior for tool calls. Also propose error codes mapping.

maya: proposal for v1 (narrow):
- Short-lived resume token (TTL 5m) that is HMAC signed and encodes model_id, model_fingerprint, request_id, offset.
- Emit machine-readable truncation event/frame: {truncated:true, truncated_at_token:N, partial:true, reason:"token_limit"} in the last chunk.
- For structured outputs (json/function_call), set partial:true and include guidance to replay with context.
- Disable automatic server-side retries for requests that indicate tool/function calls; allow server auto-retry for pure text-only requests.
- Emit metrics: per-customer truncation_rate, resume_fail_rate, duplicate_side_effect_rate.

devon: acceptance criteria candidates (react +1 if ok):
1) Resume reliability: clients should be able to resume and receive remaining tokens exactly once in >=95% of fuzz runs within TTL.
2) Truncation signal: every truncated stream includes the truncation frame and token offset.
3) No silent corruption: partial JSONs are flagged; SDKs never treat partial as final valid JSON.
4) Billing alignment: emitted tokens vs billed tokens must be reconcilable; if truncated, billing shows adjustment and a trace id.
5) Docs + SDKs: publish recommended client retry strategy and provide a "safeRetry" helper.

anil: tests to add to CI:
- SSE mid-byte cut fuzzing, verify decoder and resume logic.
- Model rotation test: resume token should be invalidated if model_fingerprint changes.
- Retry side-effect test: simulate webhook tool call + client retries -> ensure no auto-replay and surface helpful error to client.
- Multi-node resume: validate resume token without central state.

carla: scope negotiation: enterprise customers want per-customer server retry policies. For v1 we keep conservative default (no auto-retry for tool calls) and plan a v2 to add per-tenant config. Also ensure logs keep resume HMAC claims for audits.

jessica: proposed error codes for docs: 413 request_too_large (pre-reject), 422 truncated_response (body contains truncated:true), 425 resume_token_invalid, 503 transient_error (safe to retry for text-only).

devon: example streaming frames (informal):
```
:event: token
:id: r_01
:data: {"type":"token","text":"...","offset":512}

// final on truncation
:event: done
:data: {"truncated":true,"truncated_at_token":1024,"partial":true,"note":"replay_with_context"}
```

anil: implementation detail: include model_fingerprint in HMAC payload so a minor model ABI change invalidates resume tokens. Also, signer must rotate via KMS; file infra ticket.

devon: condensed test checklist (prioritized):
- resume happy path
- truncation in the middle of function/json -> partial flag + guidance
- UTF-8 split -> chunks reassembled without corruption
- resume with different auth -> reject
- client retries for tool calls -> no automatic replay
- billing parity audit logs present

carla: launch criteria draft:
- feature feature-flagged behind rollout gate
- SDK + docs updated with examples and helper functions
- CI fuzz tests for mid-stream cuts passing
- Monitoring: per-customer truncation_rate metric and alert at 0.5%
- Support KB and customer-facing recovery steps published

maya: owners and next steps:
- devon: build test harness + fuzz suite (owner)
- anil: implement resume-token signer + add model_fingerprint + open infra ticket for KMS rotation (owner)
- carla/jessica: docs, SDK helpers, and support KB (owner)
- SRE: dashboards & alerts (owner)

devon: I'll open the PR for the test harness today and include sample logs and a small simulator.

anil: filing infra ticket ENG-INFRA-508 for KMS signer rotation and key access.

carla: I'll draft the short PRD page for product + customer impact table.

jessica: prepping support KB snippets explaining the truncated flag and safe retry steps.

maya: thanks all — please react with :thumbsup: when you sign off on the v1 scope. Targeting freeze by EOD Friday.

devon: +1
anil: +1
carla: +1
jessica: +1
